answer: Verifiable-delay sequencing blocks bulk fakes. Applicants finish an hour-long chain, each step seeding the next; no parallel machine shortens it. A finished chain earns an opal seal in the ivory ledger; next chain starts only after the last seal verifies. No seal means a hollow shell. First fake costs 75 credits, 35 compute, 40 bond; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 hours and 75,000 credits vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 75 once and keep their share.
